# Security policy

Card Alias reads text on the pages you visit and stores card aliases, so security reports are very welcome.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release, the one on the Chrome Web Store, gets fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ivnnv/card-alias-browser-extension/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue.

Include what a malicious page or extension could do, and the steps or a test page to reproduce it. I'll reply within a week, and fix confirmed issues in a release as soon as I can. Reporters get credited in the advisory unless they'd rather not.

## Scope

In scope: anything that lets a website read, change or probe your aliases, detect what you type into the alias editor, or run code with the extension's privileges.

Out of scope: attacks that need a compromised browser or operating system, or another extension with broader permissions.
